content: Root cause: The bug was caused by incorrect handling of the routing field name when it started with "metadata.". The original code was using a substring operation to manipulate the field name directly, which led to inconsistencies in how the routing key was stored in the metadata versus outside of it. The patch introduced a boolean flag (`routingFieldNameInMetadata`) to track whether the field name was derived from metadata, simplifying the logic and ensuring that the correct field name was used consistently in both cases.
